description.zh: 通过 SSH 在本地 DSH 里使用远端 DSH：远端界面由桌面端整窗接管（本地侧边栏让位，内容区底部注入一条 26px 状态行：当前主机 / 远端会话标题 / 刷新 / 离开）；远端用 npx 固定本机 DSH 版本启动，Node 运行时由插件按 DSH 的 engines.node 固定安装到 ~/.dsh/remote-go/node（不碰远端系统 Node），数据在远端用户自己的 ~/.dsh；含主机清单、接入向导、连接诊断与版本一致。
description.en: Use a remote DSH over SSH inside the local DSH: the desktop client hands it the whole window (the local sidebar steps aside and a 26px status bar at the bottom of the content area switches hosts, reloads and leaves); the remote DSH is launched with npx pinned to the local version on a plugin-managed Node installed at the lower bound of DSH’s engines.node under ~/.dsh/remote-go/node (the system Node is never touched), with its data in the user’s own ~/.dsh, plus host list, connection wizard, diagnostics and exact version parity.
